caption:
If your landlord sends a rent increase, say this. 🏠
"Please send the details in writing."
Then read the notice, check your lease, and look up your local rules.
Calm and written beats angry and verbal.
Has your rent gone up this year?
first_comment: How much did your rent change this year? Rough number is fine. 👇
sources: pattern: if X happens, say this

instagram.first_comment: Rent up this year? Share the change. @paychecktruths
